title: Encouragement to Be Generous

questions.question: Paul wants them to know about the grace of God that has been given among the churches of ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:1 (ESV): "We want you to know, brothers, about the grace of God that has been given among the churches of Macedonia,"

questions.question: In a severe test of affliction, their abundance of joy and their extreme ____ have overflowed in a wealth of generosity on their part.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:2 (ESV): "for in a severe test of affliction, their abundance of joy and their extreme poverty have overflowed in a wealth of generosity on their part."

questions.question: For they gave according to their means, as I can testify, and ____ their means, of their own accord.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:3 (ESV): "For they gave according to their means, as I can testify, and beyond their means, of their own accord,"

questions.question: They begged Paul earnestly for the favor of taking part in the ____ to the saints.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:4 (ESV): "begging us earnestly for the favor of taking part in the relief of the saints—"

questions.question: But they gave themselves first to the Lord and then by the will of God to ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:5 (ESV): "and this, not as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then by the will of God to us."

questions.question: Accordingly, we urged ____ that as he had started, so he should complete among you this act of grace.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:6 (ESV): "Accordingly, we urged Titus that as he had started, so he should complete among you this act of grace."

questions.question: Paul urges them: "But as you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in all earnestness, and in our love for you—see that you excel in this ____ also."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:7 (ESV): "But as you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in all earnestness, and in our love for you—see that you excel in this act of grace also."

questions.question: Paul writes this not as a command, but to prove by the earnestness of others that your ____ also is genuine.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:8 (ESV): "I say this not as a command, but to prove by the earnestness of others that your love also is genuine."

questions.question: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sake he became ____, so that you by his poverty might become rich.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:9 (ESV): "For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sake he became poor, so that you by his poverty might become rich."

questions.question: If the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what a person ____, not according to what he does not have.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:12 (ESV): "For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what a person has, not according to what he does not have."

questions.question: For I do not mean that others should be eased and you burdened, but that as a matter of ____ your abundance at the present time should supply their need.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:13-14 (ESV): "For I do not mean that others should be eased and you burdened, but that as a matter of fairness your abundance at the present time should supply their need..."

questions.question: Paul quotes scripture: "Whoever gathered much had nothing left over, and whoever gathered little had no lack." What event is this quoting?
options: The gathering of manna in the wilderness
The gleaning of Ruth in Boaz's field
questions.correctAnswer: The gathering of manna in the wilderness
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:15 (ESV): "As it is written, 'Whoever gathered much had nothing left over, and whoever gathered little had no lack.'" This refers to Exodus 16:18, regarding the manna.

questions.question: Paul thanks God who put into the heart of Titus the same earnest ____ he himself had for them.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:16 (ESV): "But thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same earnest care I have for you."

questions.question: With Titus, Paul is sending a brother who is famous among all the churches for his ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:18 (ESV): "With him we are sending the brother who is famous among all the churches for his preaching of the gospel."

questions.question: Why did Paul and his companions take precautions regarding the administration of this generous gift?
options: To ensure no one would blame them
To hide the amount from the Romans
Lest Satan enter the hearts of the brothers
So that they might keep a portion for themselves
questions.correctAnswer: To ensure no one would blame them
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 8:20 (ESV): "We take this course so that no one should blame us about this generous gift that is being administered by us,"

key_verse_text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sake he became poor, so that you by his poverty might become rich.
